notes: Scientific state counts include every retained exploratory, campaign, repair, boundary-baseline and clean-reproduction pass; no superseded run is erased.
A search state counts a visited search node, propagated candidate, or explicitly enumerated word according to the producing method; theorem operation bounds are separate.
Clean child CPU includes interpreter/process startup. Internal CPU fields from that clean run are not charged a second time.
Prior small startup/administrative costs and one uninstrumented probe retain explicit conservative allowances; allowances are not measured runtimes.
The final clean report charges resume certificate rechecks, the example certificate check, and pilot checks; comparison and export commands add CPU but no scientific states.
Browser-mediated scholarly retrieval bytes are not exposed by the web tool. No dataset, external solver, model service, or scientific runtime dependency was downloaded into the artifact.
LaTeX compilation and visual packaging are not scientific campaign execution and are excluded from these state/obligation totals.
Exact scientific outputs reproduce; noisy timings and PDF bytes are not required to match across environments.
A later duplicate post-handoff audit replay is not folded into this frozen campaign ledger; its exact counts and the mechanical lifetime sum are disclosed in post-handoff-audit.json.
